headline: Weathered Rages On as Olavis Wake Rekindles
war_summary: Three hours on, Olavis Wake furnishes the freshest movement with four changes in the last two hours toward twenty-two in the day, the latest entry at the cutoff, while Weathered Expanse quickens to six late changes toward sixty-one in the day around Spirit Watch, Frostmarch and Crow's Nest, now standing three Warden, three Colonial and three neutral. Marban Hollow stirs again with two late changes toward twenty-six in the day at Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall, and Linn Mercy and Pari Peak hold steady with two late changes apiece toward eighteen and twenty-four in the day at Outwich Ranch and Pariah. Kuura Strand and Nevish Line, lively in the prior edition, record no change in the last two hours despite seventeen and nineteen changes in the day. Gutter and Stlican Shelf likewise stand quiet late despite forty and thirteen changes in the day. Callahan's Passage, Stonecradle and the Deadlands continue to report heavy daily casualties without a recorded base change.
